caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing armchair, specifically a Windsor-style writing armchair with a built-in desk surface. The chair is primarily dark brown or black in color with multiple red accents on the legs, spindles, and drawer pull. The seat is rounded with an attached curved back and vertical spindles forming the backrest. The right arm extends into a flat, wide writing surface that is rectangular with rounded edges. The chair stands on four turned legs, each featuring red decorative rings, and the legs are connected by horizontal stretchers. There is a drawer beneath the writing surface with a round red knob. The background is a plain, neutral light beige, and the artist's signature, "Adele Brooks," appears at the bottom right.
title: Harvard Student's Chair (Windsor)
